show:241609.title: Your Friends & Neighbors
show:241609.window: no date announced; renewed Feb 2, 2026 ahead of Season 2's April 3, 2026 premiere; outlets speculate spring/summer 2027 based on the prior seasons' pattern, not confirmed
show:241609.source: Apple TV press release (Feb 2, 2026), TVInsider, cartermatt (through Jul 2026)

show:247522.title: Tires
show:247522.window: no date announced; renewed Aug 31, 2026 after Season 3's record Netflix Top 10 run (#5 globally); some outlets speculate a Sept/Oct 2027 premiere based on the gap between earlier seasons, unconfirmed

show:199318.title: Bad Sisters
show:199318.window: not renewed as of this check; creator Sharon Horgan says she'll only return with a genuinely new story, not just "women kill again"
show:199318.source: IMDb, ScreenRant, TheReviewGeek (through Feb 2026) — no Apple TV+ renewal announcement found

show:243316.title: The Four Seasons
show:243316.window: no date announced; renewed June 15, 2026 for an 8-episode season; filming mid-Sep to mid-Dec 2026; Seasons 1-2 both dropped in May, so May 2027 is a plausible guess, though one outlet floats a possible slip into early 2028
show:243316.source: Netflix (June 15, 2026 renewal), Variety, whats-on-netflix.com, TVLine (through Aug 2026)

show:206828.title: DTF St. Louis
show:206828.window: no Season 2 confirmed — was billed as a single-season limited series; an EP has floated an anthology-style continuation as an idea, not an announcement

show:254953.title: Rooster
show:254953.window: no date announced; HBO renewed in April 2026; speculative estimates range from Q1 2027 to a specific (unconfirmed) March 7, 2027 date from a countdown site — none confirmed by HBO
show:254953.source: Deadline, Variety, TVInsider (Apr 2026 renewal), comingsoon.net, releases.com (through Aug 2026)

show:250307.title: The Pitt
show:250307.window: not yet officially dated by HBO Max, but EP John Wells said the show returns 'the same week in January' with 15 episodes; widely reported as Thursday, Jan 7, 2027; HBO Max released the first Season 3 trailer Aug 21, 2026; story reportedly picks up Nov 12, 2026
show:250307.source: TVLine, TVGuide, Forbes, cartermatt (through Aug 2026) — renewed Jan 7, 2026, trailer dropped Aug 21, 2026

show:245927.title: Paradise
show:245927.shortWindow: no date yet (early 2027 reported, final-season status unclear)
show:245927.window: no date announced; in production as of Apr 7, 2026; Marie Claire reports an early-2027 tentative window per Hulu, unconfirmed directly by Hulu; creator Dan Fogelman and EP John Hoberg describe a planned endpoint for Season 3, but whether Hulu is actually calling it the series finale remains unclear (walked back from the prior, more confident 'final season' framing)
show:245927.source: Hulu (Mar 17, 2026 renewal), Hollywood Reporter, TheWrap, Variety, Marie Claire (through mid-2026)

show:225171.title: Pluribus
show:225171.shortWindow: no date yet (late 2027 most likely, 2028 possible)
show:225171.window: no date announced; filming begins fall 2026 (cast-confirmed, Karolina Wydra); premiere estimates range from autumn 2027 (most likely, matching Season 1's Nov slot) to summer 2028 in a pessimistic case; Apple committed to a 2-season order upfront, and Vince Gilligan has said he's planning 3-4 seasons total
show:225171.source: Deadline's Crew Call podcast, TVInsider, TechRadar, Macworld, Forbes (through Aug 2026)

show:246386.title: All Her Fault
show:246386.window: no date announced; renewed ~May 2026 (TheCinemaholic exclusive, corroborated by later coverage), filming in New York summer 2026; the show was originally billed as a miniseries adaptation of Andrea Mara's novel, so the renewal itself was a genuine surprise

show:271053.title: I Love LA
show:271053.shortWindow: early 2027 (pushed back from the earlier Fall 2026 projection)
show:271053.window: renewed Nov 20, 2025; as of June 2026 the team was still writing (confirmed by Rachel Sennott) and filming hadn't started, so the earlier 'Fall 2026' estimate no longer looks realistic — most current outlets now expect early 2027
show:271053.source: HBO (Nov 20, 2025 renewal), Marie Claire, HollywoodLife, SoapCentral (through mid-2026)

show:250923.title: Nobody Wants This
show:250923.window: Netflix confirmed a Thursday, October 22, 2026 premiere for the 10-episode third season, which picks up with Joanne and Noah officially moving in together
show:250923.source: Variety, Entertainment Now, What's on Netflix (Sep 2026 announcement)

show:112211.title: Platonic
show:112211.window: no date announced; renewed Dec 2025; filming expected to begin summer 2026 per a May 2026 update; outlets estimate spring/summer 2027 for the premiere, unconfirmed by Apple
show:112211.source: TVLine, Variety, Deadline, Apple TV Press (Dec 2025 renewal), cartermatt (through May 2026)

show:117581.title: Ginny & Georgia
show:117581.window: Netflix's own press site slate update (mid-Aug 2026) groups Season 4 among its 2027 titles — superseding CEO Ted Sarandos' earlier Q3-earnings-call suggestion of a possible 2026 premiere; filming wrapped March 2026, no specific month set yet
show:117581.source: What's on Netflix (citing Netflix's press site, Aug 2026)

show:124101.title: Hacks
show:124101.window: Season 5 (the confirmed final season) aired April 9 - May 28, 2026 — the series is genuinely over, not just between seasons

show:111803.title: The White Lotus
show:111803.shortWindow: first half of 2027 (HBO-exec-confirmed window, no exact date)
show:111803.window: no exact date; HBO's Casey Bloys told Deadline at the 2026 Emmys the new season arrives in 'the first half of 2027'; production began April 15, 2026 in France (Cannes/St. Tropez/Monaco)

show:99353.title: Love is Blind
show:99353.window: Season 11 (Boston) premiered Wed Oct 14, 2026 on Netflix with the first 5 episodes; Episodes 6-8 drop Oct 21, Episodes 9-11 drop Oct 28, and the finale (Episode 12) drops Nov 4, 2026. Nick and Vanessa Lachey return as hosts. No reunion date announced yet.
